description: List the published editions of one work in the Bibliothèque nationale de France catalogue, by the identifier search_works or get_work returns. Each row carries the publisher, the place, the year, the edition statement, the extent in the words of the record, the ISBN when there is one, and the record in the BnF general catalogue. An edition that has been digitised carries a link under 'digitised'. That link says a copy exists at that address; this server never opens it, so it cannot say whether the document is readable, complete, or free to reuse. Rows are ordered by the address the catalogue gives each edition, which is neither by date nor by importance.
name: list_editions

digitised_count.description: Editions on this page carrying at least one link.

date.description: The date as published, which can be a phrase such as '[s.d.]' for an undated one.

digitised.description: Digitised copies of this edition, as links. An empty list means the catalogue records none here, not that none exists.

ark.description: The Gallica ARK identifying the document.

from_id.description: The record this link hangs off.

rendering.description: The view the address asks Gallica for, read off what follows the ARK name in it, such as 'thumbnail' for a small image or 'item' for one leaf. Null when the address names the document itself. This says what was asked for, not what comes back.

role.description: 'reproduction' is the edition itself digitised. 'ocr' is the text a machine read off it. 'depiction' is an image illustrating the record, which can be a portrait or a page mentioning the subject rather than the work.

url.description: The address the catalogue publishes, for a person to open. Read it beside 'rendering': an address asking for a rendering opens that view of the document rather than the document. This server does not read either.

edition_statement.description: Such as a numbered or revised edition.

extent.description: The extent in the words of the record: pages, volumes, discs.

id.description: The edition's own identifier in the BnF catalogue.

note.description: What the cataloguer wrote, as published.

place.description: The place of publication as the record writes it, square brackets included. '[Paris]' is a place the cataloguer supplied because the item does not print one, and '[S.l.]' is an item stating no place at all.

publisher.description: The publisher as the record writes it, square brackets included. A bracketed part is the cataloguer speaking rather than the item: '[s.n.]' is a publisher the item does not name, and a role such as '[éd., distrib.]' is what the named house did rather than part of its name.

title.description: The title as this edition carries it.

year.description: The year, when the record states one as a number.

retrieved_at.description: When these metadata were read from data.bnf.fr, as an ISO 8601 instant. The BnF licence asks for this date to be stated wherever the metadata are shown, so repeat it alongside the source.

title: List the editions of a work
